name: Itsuki Kazama
source: In 13th episode from anime, she was a subtitute pilot who replaces Tenkawa Akito after Nadesico landed into earth. Reported Killed in Action by Tetsujin's Boson jump. The nameless protagonist has a potrait of her in the prologue.
